dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 04, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**AL East Dominance and HR Barrage Across MLB**

The Boston Red Sox cruised to an 8-1 victory over the Los Angeles Angels, with Sonny Gray leading the way on the mound, striking out seven over six innings. Willson Contreras homered for the Red Sox, while Josh Lowe had a strong game for the Angels.

Meanwhile, the Baltimore Orioles outlasted the Cincinnati Reds 8-5, with Brandon Young earning the win. Samuel Basallo homered for the Orioles, while Eugenio Suárez had a crucial hit to help spark the Orioles' offense.

In other action, the Pittsburgh Pirates shut out the Washington Nationals 7-1, with Braxton Ashcraft dominating on the mound, striking out seven over 5.2 innings. Bryan Reynolds had a strong game at the plate for the Pirates, while James Wood homered for the Nationals.

The Minnesota Twins exploded for 11 runs in an 11-4 win over the New York Yankees, with Taylor Rogers earning the win. Josh Bell homered twice for the Twins, while Kody Clemens had a strong game for the Yankees.

The Seattle Mariners routed the Toronto Blue Jays 11-0, with Logan Gilbert pitching a gem, striking out seven over 7.1 innings. Randy Arozarena homered for the Mariners, while Cal Raleigh also had a big game at the plate.

The Houston Astros edged the Tampa Bay Rays 10-8, with Josh Hader earning the win. Yordan Alvarez homered twice for the Astros, while Jose Altuve also had a strong game at the plate.

The St. Louis Cardinals blanked the Chicago Cubs 3-0, with Kyle Leahy leading the way on the mound, striking out six over five innings. JJ Wetherholt homered for the Cardinals, while Alec Burleson also had a strong game at the plate.

The Atlanta Braves annihilated the New York Mets 14-3, with Chris Sale earning the win. Eli White homered for the Mets, while Michael Harris II also had a big game at the plate for the Braves.

The San Francisco Giants edged the Colorado Rockies 6-4, with Robbie Ray earning the win. Cole Carrigg homered for the Giants, while Bryce Eldridge also had a strong game at the plate.

The Philadelphia Phillies cruised to a 6-1 win over the Kansas City Royals, with Jesús Luzardo leading the way on the mound, striking out nine over six innings. Gabriel Rincones Jr. homered for the Phillies, while Alec Bohm also had a strong game at the plate.

The Chicago White Sox edged the Cleveland Guardians 3-1, with Sean Burke pitching a gem, striking out 11 over six innings. Colson Montgomery homered for the White Sox, while Tristan Peters also had a strong game at the plate.

The Miami Marlins edged the Athletics 7-2, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound, striking out eight over eight innings. Otto Lopez homered for the Marlins, while Henry Bolte also had a big game at the plate.

The Arizona Diamondbacks edged the Milwaukee Brewers 4-3, with Merrill Kelly earning the win. Adrian Del Castillo homered for the Diamondbacks, while Jackson Chourio also had a strong game at the plate.

The Los Angeles Dodgers blanked the San Diego Padres 3-0, with Yoshinobu Yamamoto pitching a gem, striking out 10 over seven innings. Freddie Freeman homered for the Dodgers, while Fernando Tatis Jr. also had a strong game at the plate for the Padres.
